arms: B: per-branch vs global-map frozen planner
config.instrument: run_closed_loop verbatim (A); K3D-faithful open-loop train + frozen planners (B)

hypothesis: The K3D branch-channel |e0| advantage translates into closed-loop control advantage: (A) intact beats L1-lesioned closed-loop; (B) per-branch planner beats global-map planner on a frozen trained model.
interpretation: EXP-AB-K3E branch-channel load-bearing test (4 fresh seeds, preregistered). Arm A (closed-loop lesion): per-seed G_A = [0.0013333333333333253, 0.016666666666666677, 0.12466666666666665, 0.036]; seed-mean +0.0447, positive 4/4 -> does not fire. Arm B (frozen planner): per-seed G_B = [0.04533333333333333, -0.0033333333333332993, -0.27733333333333327, -0.0013333333333333335]; seed-mean -0.0592, positive 1/4 -> does not fire. PREDICTION-ONLY DECORATION: the hierarchy's strongest |e0| signal does not convert into closed-loop control advantage on delayed_reward.
limitations: delayed_reward only (the env where the K3D signal lives). Closed-loop ArchB (active_inference, affect='none') dithers on delayed_reward — neither arm reaches the terminal +1.0 in 30 episodes (returns are shaping-only); the return gap measures control in the dithering regime. Arm B planners are frozen; learning effects factored out by design. ArchB's selector never queries predict_next (verified in agent.py _select_action) — the |e0| channel is disconnected from action selection by architecture. G0b determinism: PASS.
preregistered_metric: Per-seed mean episode return gap; seed-mean over 4 fresh seeds; LOAD-BEARING iff seed-mean > +0.05 AND positive on >= 3/4 seeds (both arms).

summary.verdict: PREDICTION-ONLY DECORATION: the hierarchy's strongest |e0| signal does not convert into closed-loop control advantage on delayed_reward.
